_about: ¿Para aquí o para llevar?: Mariana behind the counter of Café La Ceiba (one set-up). 12 pictures: the order, the size, the milk, the out-of-oat twist, hot or iced, something to eat, warming the torta, for here or to go, the name on the cup, paying, the receipt, the drink served. The usual-order twist keeps the greeting; the card-machine twist (said with the total) keeps the pay picture.

items.prompt: Mariana, the barista, stands behind the counter about one third from the left, both hands resting on the counter, smiling at the learner as they walk up ("¡Buenos días! ¿Qué le sirvo?").
Change only her pose: she holds up three blank paper cups of different sizes, small, medium and large, in a row at chest height, eyebrows raised, asking which size.
Change only her pose: she holds up a small steel milk pitcher in one hand and points with the other at a row of plain blank milk cartons on the back counter, head tilted (which milk?).
Change only her pose: she holds up an empty blank milk carton upside down over her open palm, nothing coming out, with an apologetic grimace (the oat milk has run out).
Change only her pose: she holds a clay mug with a little steam rising from it in one hand and a tall glass full of ice in the other, eyebrows raised (hot or iced?).
Change only her pose: she holds a pair of tongs over a pink concha in the glass case of pan dulce and gestures at the case with her other open hand, an inviting smile ("¿Algo de comer?").
Change only her pose: she holds up a plate with a torta de jamón (a crusty white roll with ham, cheese and avocado), eyebrows raised ("¿Se la caliento?").
Change only her pose: she holds a clay mug in one hand and a blank paper to-go cup with a lid in the other, at chest height, eyebrows raised (for here or to go?).
Change only her pose: she holds a blank paper to-go cup in one hand and an uncapped marker in the other, ready to write, with a friendly questioning look; nothing is written on the cup yet.
Change only her pose: she turns the card terminal toward the learner across the counter, its screen blank, a bright smile.
Change only her pose: she holds out a short strip of blank paper receipt across the counter, eyebrows raised ("¿Quiere su ticket?").

Change only her pose: she sets the finished drink on the counter in front of the learner, a clay mug of café de olla with a cinnamon stick, a concha on a small plate beside it, a wide, warm smile ("¡Que lo disfrute!").
